model.formula: readiness/5 * weighted_benefit / (1 + total_cost + dependency_risk + execution_risk), with falsification term probability/5 * value

records.title: Research-capital ledger and governed prioritization protocol
records.claim_boundary: Decision-support infrastructure only; it does not allocate resources or authorize any programme disposition.
records.next_executable_obligation: Implement and validate the exact four-record portfolio pilot under the protected review and release gates.

reversibility.pause_condition: Pause if the pilot cannot preserve unknown values or if advisory output begins to imply authority.
reversibility.termination_condition: Terminate the pilot if transparent intervals cannot be reproduced from protected records.
reopening_conditions: Reopen after a corrected model and exact-head review demonstrate restored transparency and non-authority.

disposition.rationale: The ordered prerequisite was protected and the Human Steward directed continuation into a bounded pilot.

records.title: Governed cross-programme transfer and contradiction review
records.claim_boundary: Synthesis may propose bounded transfers but cannot equate programmes by analogy or promote source or target claims.
records.next_executable_obligation: Wait for protected disposition of the portfolio pilot, then authorize a separately bounded transfer-schema tranche.

reversibility.pause_condition: Remain blocked while the portfolio contract lacks a protected disposition.
reversibility.termination_condition: Terminate a proposed transfer lane if assumptions cannot be mapped without widening either programme claim boundary.
reopening_conditions: Reopen implementation after GCL-PORTFOLIO-WP00 receives protected review, Human release, and merge.

disposition.rationale: The institutional programme requires portfolio context to be protected before synthesis implementation begins.

records.title: GitHub-native research-assurance product lane
records.claim_boundary: The lane may validate a bounded assurance workflow but cannot determine truth, novelty, patentability, or replace expert review.
records.next_executable_obligation: Wait for protected portfolio and synthesis dispositions before selecting one design-partner problem and supported contract.

reversibility.pause_condition: Remain blocked until foundational controls and one bounded user problem are protected and auditable.
reversibility.termination_condition: Terminate a candidate wedge if it cannot operate independently of internal repositories and AETHER.
reopening_conditions: Reopen after portfolio and synthesis controls are protected and a Human-approved design-partner problem is recorded.

disposition.rationale: Product work requires demonstrated portfolio and synthesis controls and cannot be prioritized by prospective commercial value alone.

records.title: Publication, prior-art, IP, and external-claim gates
records.claim_boundary: Disclosure controls enforce identity and disposition but do not determine legal validity, novelty, patentability, or commercial value.
records.next_executable_obligation: Maintain existing release controls while waiting for the ordered portfolio and synthesis packages before the new classification tranche.

reversibility.pause_condition: Keep the new tranche blocked while ordered dependencies remain unprotected; existing release controls remain effective.
reversibility.termination_condition: Terminate any classification proposal that implies CI can make legal, novelty, or patentability judgments.
reopening_conditions: Reopen implementation after the ordered prerequisites are protected or the Human Steward records a narrower exceptional authorization.

disposition.rationale: Disclosure remains strategically important, but the new tranche must not bypass ordered dependencies or existing controls.
